title: Ranger Storm Hatchet Build
lede: A lightning Hatchet build from level 1 to endgame. The guides rate Hatchets as the Ranger's strongest weapon and tag this build for solo leveling, dungeons and PvP. The Longbow is your second weapon, used to open fights from range.

notice.title: Checked against your Traits screen. Not tested in-game.
notice.text: The Hatchet tree matches your Traits screen node for node, including the red (locked) sides of each fork. Costs follow the in-game markers: "3" nodes cost 3, all others 1, and granted skills (✓) are free. Where branches split and rejoin you take one side, and the other turns red [me]. The plan spends 89 of the 94 Early Access points. The remaining 5 can't buy the 10-point stat node. Build choices and stat numbers are my recommendations.

stages.name: Leveling
stages.goal: Level in melee with Hatchets, which keep you alive better than the bow. Add the Longbow opener once you have points to spare.
skills: Flurry → Lunge → Axe Flurry is your starter chain [one]
Stormsplitter is a ground slam that adds Shock [ok]
Shadowcatch dodges behind the target and costs no SP [ok]
Thrill of the Hunt restores SP at 10 stacks [one]
traits: Diamond Shores has 11 Coilstones = 22 points: Hatchets get 20 (Stormguard shield, Discharge → Overload), Longbow gets 2 (faster free Aimed Shot) [me]
Flurry, Lunge, Axe Flurry, Windscreamer, Spinning Kick and Parry are granted free [ok]
gear: You can respec stats for free at major towns or regional camps [one]
check: Put Hatchets and Longbow on Q swap
Unlock Flurry, Lunge, Axe Flurry and Stormsplitter
Pick up every Raeven's Coilstone you pass
Reach Discharge in the trait order

stages.name: Gearing
stages.goal: Turn on the lightning loop: Discharge → Rebounding Thunder → Shocking Kick → Overload.
weapons: XLGAMES corrected its Temper stats on Nov 10, so check the current numbers before you temper it [ok]
skills: Shocking Kick and Rebounding Thunder open right after Discharge [one]
Overload makes Lunge stagger-immune and triggers Discharge [ok]
Thunder Slash combos from Shocking Kick [ok]
traits: Gylden Ruins has 14 Coilstones = +28, for 50 total: Lightning Rush and Gale Sever on the Hatchets, Fire Arrow → Scarlet Arrow on the Longbow [me]
gear: Use the Longbow's Aimed Shot → Scarlet Arrow to open on elites [ok]

stages.name: Endgame
stages.goal: Run the full shock chain and finish targets with the wind branch below 40% HP.
weapons: Thunder Dash Lunastone for Lightning ATK [ok]
Gyldenlord's Cleaver if you don't have the Claw yet [one]
Longbow for openers and ranged phases [ok]
skills: Lightning Rush: a staggering charge that evades while moving [one]
Gale Sever: 3 strikes plus 3 Wind Blades that heal you, for enemies below 40% [ok]
Eye of the Storm boosts damage, crit and Stagger after Stormsplitter [one]
traits: Astron Plains has 22 Coilstones = +44, for 94. The Longbow reaches 50 (its maximum with choices made), for 89 spent and 5 left [me]
gear: RaidDex's Talent numbers vary from page to page (12 to 35), so check your weapon's requirement [ok]
check: Raise Talent to the weapon requirement
Land Gale Sever on a boss below 40%

rotation.title: Storm Hatchet rotation
rotation.intro: Combined from RaidDex's Storm Hatchet build and the node effects in the tree [ok]. Swap weapons with {Q}.

steps.d: Aimed Shot, then Scarlet Arrow. Scarlet Arrow costs HP, so skip it when you're low.
Lunge, then Shocking Kick, then Thunder Slash. With Overload, Lunge is stagger-immune and sets off Discharge.
Rebounding Thunder and Shocking Kick open after Discharge. Relentless Hunt crits feed Thrill, which restores SP.
Axe Flurry is free with Effortless Flurry. Stormsplitter adds Shock and cuts the damage you take.
A staggering charge that evades while you move. Use it to chase kiting targets.
Flurry, Windscreamer, Windcleaver, then Gale Sever, which also heals you.

rotation.after: Use Shadowcatch (no SP) to get behind a boss's swing. If your SP runs dry, Rapid Throw costs nothing too.

disputes: RaidDex and Kybuza use it as an opener, and AOEAH rates it 8/10 for PvE. DeityVengy calls it "a dead weapon" in Early Access.
Use it only as the opener. Swap the split toward Hatchets if it underperforms.
Centurion's Hatchet had wrong Temper stats until the Nov 10 fix.
Ignore Hatchet numbers from before Nov 10.

RaidDex: AGI and Talent, then CON and END. DeityVengy: END, then Talent, then INT, and says AGI crit is weak right now. AAC Tools' demo values per point: END +6.6 SP and +4.2 defense, CON +7.2 HP, AGI +29 crit rating.
AGI first, Endurance a strong second (dodges and Rapid Throw spam drain SP), CON third, Talent to the weapon requirement [me].
Older guides say 92 or 100. RaidDex's Coilstone list: 47 × 2 = 94.

budgetIntro: Early Access has 47 Raeven's Coilstones at 2 trait points each, 94 in total [one]. Region counts are RaidDex's [one] and level bands are archeagechroniclesdata's [one]. You only reach these totals if you take every Coilstone as you go. Both weapons spend from the same pool.

weaponGuide.intro: Every Ranger starts with Hatchets, the class's default weapon [ok]. Put your first points there. The guides rate Hatchets the Ranger's strongest weapon, and the Longbow's opener skills (Rapid Shot, Piercing Shot, Aimed Shot) are free anyway.

pros: Rated 9.5/10 PvE and PvP by AOEAH, and S by a creator tier list [ok]
Self-sustain: Thrill restores SP, Stormguard shields, Gale Sever heals [one]
cons: Hardest weapon to master, per several creators [ok]
Hatchet stats before the Nov 10 Temper fix were wrong [ok]
items.skip: A Longbow-only Ranger levels slowly. Arrows have travel time and can be parried, and one creator calls the bow "a dead weapon" right now [one].

items.when: Second · 2 points early, Fire Arrow in Gylden Ruins
pros: Opens fights from range: Aimed Shot, then Scarlet Arrow [ok]
Fire Arrow and Friction add Burn and SP [one]
Aimed Shot crit line (Sniper, Fervor, Marksman) [one]
cons: Rated lower: AOEAH 8/10 PvE, a creator tier list B [ok]
items.skip: You lose ranged openers and ranged boss phases. Your damage comes almost all from melee.

plans.name: Storm Hatchets, Longbow opener early (recommended)
plans.note: 89 of 94 points. 5 are left over because the only node they could buy costs 10 [me].
route: Thrill (SP back), Stormsplitter → Stormguard (shield), then straight down the lightning line through Discharge to Overload. Add 2 Longbow points (Balanced Aim, Rapid Fire) so your free Aimed Shot opener charges faster [me].
Lightning Rush, Windcleaver and the wind line to Gale Sever (heal). On the Longbow: Fire Arrow and the Rapid Shot line to Scarlet Arrow [me].
Battle Tonic, then the Longbow crit line (Sniper → Marksman), Friction, and the kick line [me].
steps: Thrill triggers deal area damage and Shock

Free Aimed Shot opener charges faster

carry.intro: Each weapon has its own tree, but both spend from one shared point pool [ok]. Below, I sort every effect by what its node text actually says. Ends on swap means the text says so. Only that weapon covers nodes that change that weapon's own skills or say "equipped weapon". Unconfirmed means the text doesn't say either way, so I'm not guessing. One creator video reports a global cooldown when you swap mid-combo [one].

cols.label: Ends on swap (node text says so)
items: No Hatchet or Longbow node says it ends on swap. That doesn't mean they all persist (see Unconfirmed) [ok]

cols.label: Only that weapon
items: Skill upgrades only change that weapon's own skills: Overload (Lunge), Storm's Wake (Stormsplitter), Sniper (Aimed Shot), and so on [ok]
Hatchet stat cluster: Weapon Physical / Magic ATK ↑ say "weapon ATK". The plan skips them [ok]

cols.label: Unconfirmed: test before relying on it
items: Stormguard shield and Eye of the Storm buff after swapping to the Longbow [me]
Composure and Fervor stacks from Aimed Shot after swapping to Hatchets [me]
Stat nodes: Hatchet Lightning ATK +20, Longbow Fire / Tidal / Physical ATK +20 [me]

test: Stat nodes: open the Character screen with the weapon whose tree has the node (for example, Warhammer for its Fire ATK +20) and note the value. Press {Q}, then reopen the screen. If the number didn't change, the node counts for both weapons.
Shields and buffs: start the effect (a shield or timed buff), press {Q} right away, and watch the buff bar or shield. If the icon stays, it carries over.
Tell me what you see and I'll update the page. Until then, those rows stay marked as unconfirmed.
